pages.summary: Both pages are pure body text (Chapter 18, Andrew Carnegie's Emerald; no images, sidebars, or captions). The page was clear once upscaled. The metadata had MANY transcription errors, the most consequential being the author's childhood church location: the page reads "Statesville, NC" but both files said "Huntersville, NC" — a load-bearing geographic clue. The left-page raw_text was also truncated mid-page and is now completed verbatim. The right-page (Carnegie biography) raw_text was heavily garbled (OCR-style) and was rewritten verbatim; key factual fixes: textile mill (not cotton factory), twelve hours/day (not sixteen), "$1.20 per week", Scott hired him as personal secretary (not "first personal mentor"), steel business (not small business), and "released a book titled Gospel of Wealth". Notes .md facts brought into line with the image; analysis/hypothesis content left untouched. JSON re-validated (parses ok).
